rules.name: Lone Wolf
rules.description: A model upgraded to be a Lone Wolf gains the Last Stand, Monster Hunter and Expendable special rules.

rules.name: Jarl
rules.description: Only 1 Theiygn Battle Leader in your army may be upgraded to be a Jarl. A model with this upgrade gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A), Initiative (I) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. The model also gains the Battle-Hardened special rule. The model gains a Belt of Russ. They gain the Jarl Keyword.

rules.name: Rune Priest
rules.description: A model upgraded to be a Rune Priest gains the Psyker (1) and Adamantium Will special rules. In addition, the model exchanges its Chainsword for a Force Stave.

rules.name: Wolf Priest
rules.description: A model upgraded to be a Wolf Priest gains the Priest (1), Stubborn, Hatred and Zealot special rules. In addition, any attached unit gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Iron Priest
rules.description: A model upgraded to be an Iron Priest gains the Battle Smith (1) special rule. In addition, they exchange their Power Armour, Boltgun, Bolt Pistol and Chainsword for Helfrost Pistol and Tempest Hammer.

rules.name: Chosen Student
rules.description: During Deployment, select 1 Space Wolves unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique Keyword. The selected unit gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Attacks (A), Initiative (I) and Leadership (LD) characteristics for the rest of the game as Ulriks chosen student.

rules.name: Healing Balms

rules.name: Wolf Helm of Russ
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit automatically pass all Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, when calculating wounds for determining who won combat, if the unit equipped with this wargear took part in the combat, add 1 to the number of wounds inflicted by the space wolves for calculating who won combat.

rules.name: Tempest’s Wrath
rules.description: Each time Njal Stormcaller successfully casts a Psychic Power, all enemy units within 12” take D6 Strength 3 automatic hits with no AP. Wound rolls must be made as normal. Saves may be taken as normal.

rules.name: Storm Caller
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all attacks in the Shooting Phase against this unit and any attached unit are resolved as Snap Shots.

selectionEntries.name: The Last of the Company of Russ

rules.name: The Last of the Company of Russ
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all friendly Space Wolves units that can draw visibility to this unit may re-roll failed Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, this unit counts as a Chapter Banner.

rules.name: Lessons of Russ
rules.description:
The following restrictions apply to stalwart traditionalist space wolves who heed no master but Leman Russ:
• Space Wolves units may never voluntarily be placed in Deep Strike or use the Deep Strike special rule. This does not apply to Space Wolves Drop Pod units. Space Wolves units forced into Deep Strike reserves may arrive via Deep Strike.
• If your opponent is fielding Thousand Sons, you must play 1 additional Battle Round of the game, regardless of the rules in the Battlepack.
• You may not take Allies from Codex – Imperial Agents.

rules.name: Vlka Fenryka
rules.description:
Space Wolves units gain the following benefits:
• They gain the Night Vision special rule.
• They gain the Counter-Attack special rule.

sharedRules.name: True Grit
sharedRules.description: All Boltguns and Storm Bolters a unit with this special rule are equipped with are treated as Pistol 2 type while the equipped unit is within 3” of an enemy unit.

sharedRules.name: Curse of the Wulfen
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule has +1 to its Strength (S) and Attacks (A) characteristics. In addition, it gains the Frenzy special rule.

rules.name: Blizzard Shield
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save and gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Wolf Tail Talisman
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Indomitable Spirit (6+) special rule.

rules.name: Belts of Russ
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

rules.name: Thunderwolf Cavalry
rules.description: A model with this wargear becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, the equipped model gains +1 to their Strength (S), Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristics. The equipped model also gains 1 additional Close Combat Weapon.

rules.name: Runic Armour
rules.description: This wargear confers a 2+ Armour Save and the Indomitable Spirit (5+) special rule.

rules.name: Cult of Morkai
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Adamantium Will and Deny the Witch special rules. In addition, if they have the Indomitable Spirit (X) special rule, improve the value of (x) by 1 (to a max of 2+).

rules.name: Howl of the Wolf
rules.description: Once per game, a Warlord with this trait may declare it will howl. For the rest of that turn, all Space Wolves units in your army gain the benefits of the Fear (1) and Sprint (2) special rule.

rules.name: Rage of the Berserker
rules.description: This Warlord gains the Rage and Furious Charge special rules.

rules.name: Saga of Majesty
rules.description: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Saga of the Bear
rules.description: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic.

rules.name: Saga of the Beast Slayer
rules.description: A model with this Saga gains the Monster Hunter special rule.

rules.name: Saga of the Hunter
rules.description: A model with this Saga gains the Infiltrate special rule.

rules.name: Saga of the Warrior Born
rules.description: A model with this Saga gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Saga of the Wolfkin
rules.description: A model with this Saga may join Beast type units even if it is not the Beast type.

selectionEntries.name: Jaws of the World Wolf (Psychic Power)

rules.name: Jaws of the World Wolf
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. Each model in the unit must immediately make a Dangerous Terrain test. This Psychic Power may not target a unit with the Fly special rule.

rules.name: Tempest’s Wrath
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, select a single enemy unit within 18” of the Psyker. The target enemy unit has -1 to hits rolls until the start of your next Shooting Phase. In addition, units with the Fly special rule take D6, Strength 6, AP- Automatic Hits.

rules.name: The Wolf Spirits
rules.description: When this Psychic Power is cast, immediately summon 1 unit of Spirit Wolves (see below) within 12” of the Psyker and more than 3” away from any enemy models. Each time this power is cast, the previously summoned unit of Spirit Wolves is removed from play and a fresh unit is summoned instead following the rules above. Each Psyker in your army may only Summon 1 unit of Spirit Wolves at a time. Spirit Wolves never count for Victory Points.

rules.name: The Storm’s Eye
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic may re-roll 1 dice when making a Psychic Test.

rules.name: The Armour of Russ
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains a 2+ Save. In additional, all enemy units within 3” of a model equipped with this Relic in the Combat Phase suffer -1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic.

rules.name: The Helm of Durfast
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains the Linked special rule on all equipped Shooting Weapons. In addition, the bearer and any attached unit gain the Ignores Cover special rule on their equipped Shooting Weapons.

rules.name: The Mountain Breaker Helm
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains the Hammer of Wrath (1) special rule. This does not stack with other Hammer of Wrath (x) special rules even when noted. However, the bearers Hammer of Wrath Attacks are resolved at Strength 10.
